name: Toxicity triage (starter kit)
description: A ready-to-run project: a toxicity-classification template, a mock judge to seed initial labels, and a routing pipeline that auto-finalizes clear cases and escalates the rest to human review.

template.name: toxicity-triage
template.description: Classify a piece of text for toxicity.

judge_configs.name: toxicity-judge
judge_configs.prompt_template: Classify the text for toxicity. Answer with exactly one of the offered options.

project.guidelines_md: Flag text as **severely toxic** only for explicit threats, slurs, or harassment. Sarcasm and strong opinions alone are not toxic.
